gatoh.agents.agents.Agent.radicalisation

Agent.radicalisation(hierarchy_changes: list[float], neighbour_benefits: list[bool], hierarchies: list[str], threshold: float) → bool[source]

Uses the agent’s own opinion as well as the neighbours’ opinions to determine if the agent has become radicalised in their actions.

Parameters:

  • hierarchy_changes (list[float]) – The opinion changes caused in each social hierarchy by neighbours during this iteration.

  • neighbour_benefits (list[bool]) – Flags indicating the presence of personal benefit across an agent’s neighbours.

  • hierarchy_names (list[str]) – Hierarchy names in an order corresponding to the passed hierarchy changes.

  • threshold (float) – The radicalisation threshold that has been defined at the global level in the model.

Returns:

A flag indicating if the Agent has become radicalised or not.

Return type:

bool
